sections.name: goal
sections.value: A prime plans, starts, takes down and brings back a group of seats as one pod.

value.title: The pod definition and where pods live
value.done_when: A pod definition validates against its schema, pod paths under `community/` are written only by pij, and memory is filed per role instance.

value.title: Plan, up and show
value.done_when: `plan` changes nothing, `up` starts a pod together or one seat at a time, `show` displays it, and the spawn counter moves only for new seats.

value.title: Set, down, revive and reshape
value.done_when: A late parameter reaches only the members that need it; `down` takes every member down the same way a single close does, skips keep-open members with a warning and touches no consulted role; a closed pod comes back by name; and a seat added mid-run is logged.

value.change: Owner moves from pij-autonomous-parrot to pm-001, which runs the build of PRDs 006, 007, 008 and 010 (operator's approval, 2026-11-25).
